name: hcportal_rejectKennelRequest
description: Closes kennel requests without creating a kennel (E12.F1.S5) — rejected (3), spam (4) or duplicate (5), with an optional note — or reopens a closed one (1). Several ids at once, '|'-delimited. Never touches a request that is approved (RequestStatus 2) or already has a kennel. Since 2026-10-11 a call that changes nothing returns Success = 0 with the reason. Replaces the DELETE branch of the HC3W INSTEAD OF trigger on EXT.vwOfficeForms_KennelImport. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; caller must hold a live HC.PlatformAdmin row with CanEditKennel = 1.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Portal token; standard param string (device secret).

parameters.name: kennelImportIds
parameters.description: One or more KennelImportIds, '|'-delimited; values that are not GUIDs are ignored. Required (no SQL default).

parameters.name: newStatus
parameters.description: 1 reopen · 3 rejected · 4 spam · 5 duplicate. Anything else is refused. Required (no SQL default).

parameters.name: reviewNote
parameters.description: Optional, at most 1000 characters after trimming (longer is refused); replaces the old note when given, keeps it when NULL/blank.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always one row. Success = 0 on auth failure, missing CanEditKennel, bad/missing parameters, a note over 1000 characters, nothing changed ('This request already has a kennel…' or 'No request was changed — it may have been closed already'), or from the CATCH block (ROLLBACK, HC.ErrorLog row, ERROR_MESSAGE()). Success = 1 with the number of requests changed.

sideEffects: UPDATE EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport for the listed ids that are not approved and have no kennel: RequestStatus, ReviewNote (when given), ReviewedBy, ReviewedAt, ConfirmCode (cleared unless reopening), removed (0 on reopen, else 1), updatedAt
On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog after the ROLLBACK

codeSmells.detail: Line 4: @kennelImportIds NVARCHAR(MAX) has no default. A client that omits it gets SQL's 'expects parameter' refusal (an unlogged empty 500) and the SP's own 'kennelImportIds and newStatus … are required' check on line 62 never runs.
Line 5: @newStatus SMALLINT has no default; omitting it is an unlogged empty 500 for the same reason.
